title: Casa de Coral Azul
description: Rincón is the perfect place to stay on Puerto Rico’s west coast. Our home is a short walk from beautiful beaches and the town plaza, where you’ll find great restaurants, the Thursday art walk, and the Sunday farmers market. A quick drive takes you to Route 413, famous surf spots, and the Tres Palmas Marine Reserve for snorkeling. You can also book a fishing charter, take surf lessons, rent a paddleboard, or go scuba diving.The spaceThe entire three bedroom place it's modern with AC units in every rooms and a large private patio with hammock in the back. The place is centrally located, only 10 minutes walk from the beach, 5 minutes walk from downtown Rincon, where all the good restaurant, bar and grocery are. Although it's close to downtown the place is on the cul-de-sacs so it's very quiet and safe. In addition if you rent a car I have two parking space in front of the house, which is rare in Rincon. The unit is on the second floor of a duplex and the first floor is reserve for me as my vacation's house. If I'm there you're welcome to ask me to show you around. Rincon is a surf town but also very good for snorkeling, diving kite surfing and many other activitiesGuest accessguests have access to the second floor and the front yard including the outside shower

description: Our little slice of paradise is less than 100 yards from the beach in one of the best surf towns in the Caribbean! Our home boasts a covered terrace on the ground floor, a balcony on the 2nd floor, and a roof deck on top of it all, where you can enjoy sunsets after a long day of surfing, paddle boarding, scuba diving, fishing or just relaxing on the beach. With a shared condo pool and clubhouse right across the street, this is the perfect spot for your next family vacation!The spaceOur stand-alone casita inside the Puerto Bahia complex has been meticulously customized and furnished to meet your family's every need! The ground floor has a kitchen and spacious living area, plus a smaller TV/family room with a queen pull out couch. There's a half-bath on the first floor as well as a covered outdoor shower on the terrace that completes the downstairs full bath, which serves as a private bath for anyone sleeping in the family room pull-out.Upstairs you will find three bedrooms, a master bedroom with a queen size bed and connected en-suite bathroom, and two guest bedrooms, one with a queen bed, and one with full size bunked beds plus a trundle bed. There is also a shared full bath, and a washer and dryer on this floor.On the beach side of the house is a balcony shared by the master bedroom and the queen guest bedroom. Step onto this second floor balcony and you'll find a spiral staircase leading up to a rooftop deck where you can take in some sun or simply enjoy the views!We upgraded our apartment WIFI to 200mbps during the pandemic, and because we know the weather and infrastructure in PR can be unpredictable, we installed a rooftop diesel generator that kicks in automatically anytime there's an outage, so you can rest assured of your comfort and safety.Whether you're a regular to Rincón, or a first time visitor, our beautiful beachfront casita will help you make memories for a lifetime!Guest accessThe entire house is yours to use. In addition, we are across the street from the shared complex pool and pool clubhouse, which has a 5 ft. deep pool for adults and a 2 ft. deep kiddie pool for the children.Other things to notePlease note that this apartment is a part-time residence for the owners, and is not just a vacation rental. As such, the furniture, appliances and decorations are all high quality, and were picked to make this property feel like a home, please treat our home with the same care and respect you would your own.

title: 1: Private Pool, Ocean Views & Walk to Sandy Beach
description: RELAX and Enjoy Island TimeLocated only seven houses up the road from Sandy Beach, You’ll be able to enjoy this quiet and quaint economical casita located in the heart of the well known Puntas neighborhood with it’s handful of restaurants, bars, food trucks, and other amenities like yoga, and surfboard rentals, and some of the best surf breaks. This casita is ideal for couples or solo travelers who want to get away, disconnect and enjoy Rincon at their own pace.The spaceThis casita is cozy and rustic, ideal for couples or solo travelers. Enjoy beautiful ocean views, the Caribbean breeze, Wifi, AC in the bedroom, and is walkable to beaches and local restaurants and establishments. There is a small kitchen and a back balcony where you can enjoy your favorite beverage while taking in the ocean view/ sunset and hearing the waves. While this isn't a luxury hotel accommodation, this casita is quiet, cute, comfortable, clean, low key & very relaxing.The property has an automatic generator that powers on in the event of utility loss. Guests should be mindful of electric consumption while on backup generator power.Guest accessGuests will have access to their private rented casita.The grassy yard, parking, laundry and stairway are shared spaces for all of Cozy Casita guests to enjoy.Other things to noteThere are three (1-bedroom) casitas on property each with their own private patio or balcony area. The driveway, stairs, laundry and grassy yard are shared spaces for all of Cozy Casita guests to access.During your visit you may encounter some of the Caribbean wildlife that live among us. You may hear coquis (our endemic frog), roosters, horses and may receive the visit of iguanas in the trees.There are also many opportunities to observe birds like Venezuelan troupials, red hawks, Puerto Rican parrots and grey kingbirds. Rincon is full of small hills. This property happens to be on one so the driveway until getting used to it may seem a bit steep. A 4x4 is Not necessary.We reserve the right to cancel/limit bookings based on number of nights during Holiday weeks/weekends (3-5 days) Exceptions to the rule applyWe are located on the western point of the island. We are2.5 hours from SJU Airport, 35 minutes from both BQN & MAZ airports and 1.5 hours from PSE Airport in Ponce. To avoid the drive from San Juan there is a Cape Air flight that goes direct multiple times a day from SJU to MAZ.

title: La Ola Suite | Poolside Coastal Retreat
description: La Pina Boutique hotel has just been refreshed top to bottom, the La Ola Suite is a spacious one-bedroom retreat steps from Rincon’s most secluded beach. The suite features a memory foam bed with luxurious linens, large kitchenette, comfortable living area, full bathroom, and direct pool access just outside. Guests enjoy access to the rooftop sunset deck with fire pits, outdoor BBQ and kitchen area, plus complimentary beach chairs, umbrella, cooler, and towels for relaxing beach days.The spaceTucked within one of Rincon’s oldest and quietest beachside neighborhoods, La Piña Boutique Hotel offers a peaceful boutique escape centered around relaxation, authenticity, and coastal living. With only seven suites and a maximum of 16 guests on property, the atmosphere remains calm, intimate, and uncrowded — a refreshing alternative to larger resorts.Located less than 100 feet from one of Rincon’s most secluded hidden beaches, guests can enjoy swimming, snorkeling, sunset walks, and quiet beach days just steps from their suite. A relaxed beachfront bar sits directly on the shoreline, offering sunset views, ocean breezes, live local conversation, and one of the area’s most authentic hidden gems.Despite the peaceful setting, the hotel remains centrally located to everything Rincon has to offer — including beaches, restaurants, coffee shops, nightlife, surf spots, and the historic town plaza. Guests can explore the famous Thursday night Art Walk in the Pueblo featuring local artisans, handmade goods, live music, outdoor dining, and dancing throughout the town square. Sunday mornings also bring Rincon’s beloved local farmers market filled with fresh produce, crafts, and island flavors.Guests also enjoy access to the hotel’s swimming pool, rooftop sunset deck with fire pits, outdoor BBQ patio, and complimentary beach essentials including chairs, umbrellas, towels, and coolers for effortless beach days.For those seeking adventure or relaxation, nearby rentals and experiences include snorkeling, bicycles, dive lessons, beach massages, and guided local excursions — all conveniently close to the hotel.Guest accessDuring your stay, you will have access to all the amenities at La Piña, including a swimming pool, outdoor patio with loungers and umbrellas, an outdoor kitchen and BBQ, and our favorite feature, the rooftop sunset deck with fire pits. Or grab our complimentary beach chairs, towels, and umbrella, and head to the sand! (Blue and White striped towels are for pool and beach use. Please leave grey towels in your room) Your room includes a complete kitchenette with a microwave, refrigerator, coffee maker (FRESH local Puerto Rican coffee included), electric hot plate, and all necessary pots, pans, plates, and utensils. The laundry room is free to use, and laundry soap is included. In addition, all rooms come with shampoo, conditioner, body wash, and hand soap.Other things to noteBlue and white towels are for pool and beach use. Please leave grey towels in the room for showering and bathing. Please use the footwash by the front entrance or one of the two outdoor public showers to rinse off the sand before getting into the pool. All kitchens have cleaning supplies under the sink and a fire extinguisher. First aid kits are located under the bathroom sink and a large first aid kit is located in the laundry mounted on the wall by the door.
